in_sanskrit.name: Dristika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sight, Vision
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dristika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dristika is a Sanskrit and Hindu name derived from the word 'drishti', meaning sight or vision. This name represents a deep sense of insight and intelligence, as well as the ability to perceive the world around us with clarity and understanding.
